checks.text: The page displays the heading "Graphing Calculator" and the text "No functions plotted yet" in the empty state area.
Typing "x^2" in the field labelled "Function expression", clicking the button "Plot function", adds a list item containing "x^2" and the text "No functions plotted yet" is removed.
With "x^2" plotted, the tab labelled "Table" shows a table where the row for x = 2 contains the value "4" in the column labelled "y".
Clicking the button "Delete x^2" removes the function from the list and the text "No functions plotted yet" reappears.

Typing "2x + 1" in the field labelled "Function expression" and clicking "Plot function" adds a list item containing "2x + 1"; the tab labelled "Table" shows the row for x = 0 contains the value "1" in the column labelled "y".

With "x^2" plotted, changing the field labelled "X min" to "-5" and the field labelled "X max" to "5", the tab labelled "Table" shows rows for x = -5 and x = 5, with y values "25" and "25" respectively.
Clicking the button "Export PNG" triggers a file download named "graph.png".

Typing "log(x)" in the field labelled "Function expression" and clicking "Plot function" adds a list item containing "log(x)"; the tab labelled "Table" shows the row for x = 1 contains the value "0" in the column labelled "y".
Reload keeps the function "x^2" in the list and the table row for x = 2 showing the value "4".
